rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for deliberately waving a weapon to threaten or show off.

example.english: They brandish a knife in the street, frightening everyone into leaving at once.
example.traditional: 嗰個人喺街上揮舞把刀，嚇到大家即刻走晒。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 jan4 hai2 gaai1 soeng6 fai1 mou5 baa2 dou1 haak3 dou3 daai6 gaa1 zik1 hak1 zau2 saai3

rows.traditional: 拎住 + CL + N + 揮嚟揮去
rows.jyutping: ling1 zyu6 CL N fai1 lai4 fai1 heoi3
rows.note: Use this colloquial construction when vividly describing someone holding a weapon and waving it back and forth.

example.english: They brandish a knife while waving it back and forth, so nobody dares say a word.
example.traditional: 嗰個人拎住把刀揮嚟揮去，成班人都唔敢出聲。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 jan4 ling1 zyu6 baa2 dou1 fai1 lai4 fai1 heoi3 sing4 baan1 jan4 dou1 m4 gam2 ceot1 seng1
